cd /office; python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv
obj={'J01':'HZ-A','J02':'JL-B','J03':'NP-B','J04':'HZ-B','J05':'YC-A','J06':'QH-B',
     'J07':'JL-A','J08':'BA-B','J09':'QH-A','J10':'NP-A','J11':'YC-B','J12':'BA-A'}
review_prefix={'HZ','NP','BA'}
rows=[]
for k in sorted(obj):
    code=obj[k].split('-')[0].lower()
    exp=f"{code}.review@office.test" if obj[k].split('-')[0] in review_prefix else f"{code}.service@office.test"
    keep=f"{code}.service@office.test"
    rows.append([k,exp,keep])
with open('out/通讯.csv','w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\r\n'); w.writerow(['案号','解释邮箱','维持邮箱']); w.writerows(rows)
print(open('out/通讯.csv').read())
EOF
